government.note: Parliamentary republic with a unicameral Hellenic Parliament of 300 members. The President is elected by Parliament for five years: 200 votes are needed in the first two ballots and 180 in the third; under the rules described for 2020 a failed third ballot forced the dissolution of Parliament (as in December 2014, which led to the January 2015 election), while in 2025 a fourth ballot needed only an absolute majority (151). When no party can form a government, a caretaker Prime Minister is appointed until a new election, as in 2012, 2015 and 2023.

system.note: List PR in multi-member constituencies with a 3% national threshold and, in most elections, a majority bonus for the first party. The 2016 law abolished the bonus (applied in 2019 and May 2023); the 2020 law restored it from June 2023: 20 extra seats at 25% plus one per half point above 25%, up to 50 at 40%. seats_2000 is the result of the September 1996 election; the April 2000 election fell after the game start.
